versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֣וּ בָ֭נִים מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לָדַ֥עַת בִּינָֽה׃

controles.web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
controles.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
controles.livre: Ouvi, filhos, a correção do pai; e prestai atenção, para que conheçais o entendimento.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֶ֣קַח ט֭וֹב נָתַ֣תִּי לָכֶ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹרָתִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ׃

controles.web: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
controles.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
controles.livre: Pois eu vos dou boa doutrina; não deixeis a minha lei.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־בֵ֭ן הָיִ֣יתִי לְאָבִ֑י רַ֥ךְ וְ֝יָחִ֗יד לִפְנֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

controles.web: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
controles.kjv: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
controles.livre: Porque eu era filho do meu pai; tenro, e único perante a face de minha mãe.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּרֵ֗נִי וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֗י יִֽתְמָךְ־דְּבָרַ֥י לִבֶּ֑ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶֽחְיֵֽה׃

controles.web: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
controles.kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
controles.livre: E ele me ensinava, e me dizia: Que teu coração retenha minhas palavras; guarda meus mandamentos, e vive.

versos.hebraico: קְנֵ֣ה חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה בִינָ֑ה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח וְאַל־תֵּ֝֗ט מֵֽאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

controles.web: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, neither swerve from the words of my mouth.
controles.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
controles.livre: Adquire sabedoria, adquire entendimento; e não te esqueças nem te desvies das palavras de minha boca.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶ֥הָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶ֑ךָּ אֱהָבֶ֥הָ וְתִצְּרֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
controles.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
controles.livre: Não a abandones, e ela te guardará; ama-a, e ela te conservará.

versos.hebraico: רֵאשִׁ֣ית חָ֭כְמָה קְנֵ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־קִ֝נְיָנְךָ֗ קְנֵ֣ה בִינָֽה׃

controles.web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
controles.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
controles.livre: O principal é a sabedoria; adquire sabedoria, e acima de tudo o que adquirires, adquire entendimento.

versos.hebraico: סַלְסְלֶ֥הָ וּֽתְרוֹמְמֶ֑ךָּ תְּ֝כַבֵּ֗דְךָ כִּ֣י תְחַבְּקֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor, when you embrace her.
controles.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
controles.livre: Exalta-a, e ela te exaltará; quando tu a abraçares, ela te honrará.

versos.hebraico: תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭רֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵ֑ן עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת תְּמַגְּנֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
controles.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
controles.livre: Ela dará a tua cabeça um ornamento gracioso; ela te entregará uma bela coroa.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי וְקַ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י וְיִרְבּ֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
controles.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
controles.livre: Ouve, filho meu, e recebe minhas palavras; e elas te acrescentarão anos de vida.

versos.hebraico: בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ חָ֭כְמָה הֹרֵתִ֑יךָ הִ֝דְרַכְתִּ֗יךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹֽשֶׁר׃

controles.web: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.
controles.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
controles.livre: Eu te ensino no caminho da sabedoria; e te faço andar pelos percursos direitos.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽ֭לֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַ֣ר צַעֲדֶ֑ךָ וְאִם־תָּ֝ר֗וּץ לֹ֣א תִכָּשֵֽׁל׃

controles.web: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
controles.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
controles.livre: Quando tu andares, teus passos não se estreitarão; e se tu correres, não tropeçarás.

versos.hebraico: הַחֲזֵ֣ק בַּמּוּסָ֣ר אַל־תֶּ֑רֶף נִ֝צְּרֶ֗הָ כִּי־הִ֥יא חַיֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
controles.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
controles.livre: Toma a correção para si, e não a largues; guarda-a, porque ela é tua vida.

versos.hebraico: בְּאֹ֣רַח רְ֭שָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹ֑א וְאַל־תְּ֝אַשֵּׁ֗ר בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ רָעִֽים׃

controles.web: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
controles.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
controles.livre: Não entres pela vereda dos perversos, nem andes pelo caminho dos maus.

versos.hebraico: פְּרָעֵ֥הוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּ֑וֹ שְׂטֵ֖ה מֵעָלָ֣יו וַעֲבֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
controles.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
controles.livre: Rejeita-o! Não passes por ele; desvia-te dele, e passa longe.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יִֽ֭שְׁנוּ אִם־לֹ֣א יָרֵ֑עוּ וְֽנִגְזְלָ֥ה שְׁ֝נָתָ֗ם אִם־לֹ֥א יכשולו׃

controles.web: For they don’t sleep, unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
controles.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
controles.livre: Pois eles não dormem se não fizerem o mal; e ficam sem sono, se não fizerem tropeçar a alguém .

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לָ֭חֲמוּ לֶ֣חֶם רֶ֑שַׁע וְיֵ֖ין חֲמָסִ֣ים יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃

controles.web: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
controles.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
controles.livre: Porque comem pão da maldade, e bebem vinho de violências.

versos.hebraico: וְאֹ֣רַח צַ֭דִּיקִים כְּא֣וֹר נֹ֑גַהּ הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ֝א֗וֹר עַד־נְכ֥וֹן הַיּֽוֹם׃

controles.web: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light, that shines more and more until the perfect day.
controles.kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
controles.livre: Mas o caminho dos justos é como a luz brilhante, que vai, e ilumina até o dia ficar claro por completo.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣רֶךְ רְ֭שָׁעִים כָּֽאֲפֵלָ֑ה לֹ֥א יָ֝דְע֗וּ בַּמֶּ֥ה יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃פ

controles.web: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
controles.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
controles.livre: O caminho dos perversos é como a escuridão; não sabem nem em que tropeçam.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭נִי לִדְבָרַ֣י הַקְשִׁ֑יבָה לַ֝אֲמָרַ֗י הַט־אָזְנֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
controles.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
controles.livre: Filho meu, presta atenção às minhas palavras; e ouve as minhas instruções.

versos.hebraico: אַל־יַלִּ֥יזוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝מְרֵ֗ם בְּת֣וֹךְ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the midst of your heart.
controles.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
controles.livre: Não as deixes ficarem longe de teus olhos; guarda-as no meio de teu coração.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־חַיִּ֣ים הֵ֭ם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶ֑ם וּֽלְכָל־בְּשָׂר֥וֹ מַרְפֵּֽא׃

controles.web: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
controles.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
controles.livre: Porque são vida para aqueles que as encontram; e saúde para todo o seu corpo.

versos.hebraico: מִֽכָּל־מִ֭שְׁמָר נְצֹ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ תּוֹצְא֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
controles.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
controles.livre: Acima de tudo o que se deve guardar, guarda o teu coração; porque dele procedem as saídas da vida.

versos.hebraico: הָסֵ֣ר מִ֭מְּךָ עִקְּשׁ֣וּת פֶּ֑ה וּלְז֥וּת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם הַרְחֵ֥ק מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

controles.web: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
controles.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
controles.livre: Afasta de ti a perversidade da boca; e põe para longe de ti a corrupção dos lábios.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ לְנֹ֣כַח יַבִּ֑יטוּ וְ֝עַפְעַפֶּ֗יךָ יַיְשִׁ֥רוּ נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
controles.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
controles.livre: Teus olhos olhem direito; tuas pálpebras estejam corretas diante de ti.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֭לֵּס מַעְגַּ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ יִכֹּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
controles.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
controles.livre: Pondera o curso de teus pés; e todos os teus caminhos sejam bem ordenados.

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תֵּט־יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול הָסֵ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מֵרָֽע׃

controles.web: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
controles.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
controles.livre: Não te desvies nem para a direita, nem para a esquerda; afasta teus pés do mal.
